_README: For not_in_docs Build questions whose Library holds something close to the answer. A refusal is GENUINE when the setup retrieved evidence matching one of these patterns (regex, case-insensitive) and still said 'not found'; HOLLOW when it retrieved none of it, so it refused without seeing the near-miss. Questions not listed have no near-miss in the Library: their refusals are counted as refused only. Build set only (the original questions and the added group) - the Test set stays closed.
